# lokalise_team_user_group (Resource)

A team user group on a Lokalise team. This resource manages exactly the group's own fields (name, role_id/admin_rights, languages); it never adds or removes members or project assignments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lokalise_permission_template" "translator" {
  team_id = 123456
  name    = "Translator"
}

resource "lokalise_team_user_group" "french_translators" {
  team_id = 123456
  name    = "French translators"

  # Exactly one of role_id or admin_rights must be set.
  role_id = data.lokalise_permission_template.translator.role_id
  # admin_rights = ["upload", "download"]

  languages = {
    reference     = ["en"]
    contributable = ["fr"]
  }
}

# Members and project assignments are managed by
# lokalise_team_user_group_member and lokalise_team_user_group_project; this
# resource only manages the group's own name/role/languages.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name.
- `team_id` (Number) Lokalise team ID. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `admin_rights` (Set of String) Explicit set of admin rights to assign. Conflicts with `role_id`; exactly one of the two must be set.
- `languages` (Attributes) Languages this group may access, as system language ISO codes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--languages))
- `role_id` (Number) Permission template ID to assign (see `lokalise_permission_template`). Conflicts with `admin_rights`; exactly one of the two must be set.

### Read-Only

- `group_id` (Number) Lokalise group ID.
- `id` (String) `team_id:group_id`.

<a id="nestedatt--languages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `languages`

Optional:

- `contributable` (Set of String) Languages the group may translate.
- `reference` (Set of String) Languages the group may view but not translate.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import lokalise_team_user_group.french_translators <team_id>:<group_id>
```
